steps.text: Wake up!!!
Wake up.... Wake up!
Come, Adam! Bring warm water!
Dad...
She's alive! Great, she's alive! Thank the ancestors!
Adam! Move it!
Dad...? Dad...?
Dad?
Yes, yes! I'm Dad, certainly!
Don't sleep. Don't sleep! Hold Daddy's hand and don't let go!
Don't sleep, my daughter! Stay with us!
Her body temperature keeps dropping! Mishka, do something!
No way to tilt the flow?
It's cold...! Daddy! I'm cold!
...Daughter... My daughter! Hold on!
Daddy, don't.... Don't ever leave me again....
Ruins of Chernobog 'District 14'
Upper superstructure levels

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I'm awake.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: You didn't kill me while I was unconscious. Is that confidence or something else?

options: This sort of thing has happened before....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: In any case, you didn't.

options: Probably because you've been talking in your sleep.
Can I ask you about your life?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I'll take that as a sign that you've shown mercy. Now if I don't kill you, I'd call that returning the favor.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Why the consternation on your face?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Is it because...? You heard everything I saw in my dream?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: It seems I really did reveal something very unpleasant in my stupor.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Memories are something you can't lose even if you want to.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Have you explored our surroundings?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Couldn't find a way out, could you?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Looks like we won't be able to leave this place for a while.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: My father, as I call him, is named Buldrokkas'tee and was once an officer in the Ursus military.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: But my real father died a long time ago.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: As a child I vaguely remember a man taking a crossbow bolt to protect a woman; and the woman took me in her arms and stopped the second volley of bolts with her spine.

options: You witnessed it with your own eyes....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I couldn't even comprehend what was happening at the time, and this memory just happened to never fade.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: As for what really happened, it was my grandmother who told me all about it later.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: When I pressed my grandmother for the meaning of that vision, and she had no more excuses, she told me.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: 'They were your real parents.... and they died protecting you.'

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The funny thing is, I don't know them at all. I don't have any memories of them in my mind other than that vision.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: My own parents were just forgotten. It's hard for me to even say I have any feelings for them.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Half and half. The other half was the blood of the Ursus Infected.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Ugh....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I was born in a mine in the northwest tundra.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The mine was small and remote, not part of any city, and there are with no settlements around. There was nothing to see but snow all year round.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: This mine was hell, built only to spread death and slavery. There are countless such mines in the snowy plains.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: My birth parents were miners in that hellish pit.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: My grandmother stayed with me through my early years of learning to speak, but she never told me what crimes my parents committed to be sentenced to mine labor.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Later, when I was a little older, I asked around in the mines and learned that both of my parents had opposed the Emperor's wartime plans.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Their arrest was also an accident. The bottom two lines of the arrest warrant were blank, so the sergeant in charge of the search haphazardly copied the name on the door plate.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Without trial, my parents lost their names and moved from their warm little town to the cold Northlands to serve a centuries-long sentence.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Of course, no one would even live to see that, let alone ever leave alive.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: My grandmother was sentenced to the mines together as a 'harborer' of criminals, and moved with them.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: In fact, all the miners there had very similar experiences.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Naturally, both of my parents contracted Oripathy down there. All the miners did.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Now, even if you escaped this mine, no one would believe a word you said. You're just an Infected person, the most horrible, vicious and extreme of the Oripathy patients.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: However, the overseer of the mine, a certain Ursus military garrison, believed that the natural death rate of the Infected was still too slow.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: They drew straws to decide the fates of the Oripathy sufferers, killing them for fun and sport.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Maybe it was the miners that drove them crazy, rather than the snow. And maybe the Infected didn't count as human in their eyes.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: When I was five, my parents drew the black lot.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: When I was ten, my grandmother drew the black lot.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: When I was eleven, I drew the black lot myself, but it didn't matter, they didn't care about the lottery anymore. They just want to abandon the whole mine.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: By that time, all the adult Infected in the mines had died out, and the Emperor's new policies had left the mines starved of people.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Under orders, the Ursus overseers prepared to go ahead and execute the last of the Infected.... A few sick children.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Afterwards they would collapse the mines to serve as mass graves for the infected, to cover up their sins.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I learned later, in my travels, that they do this all the time.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I was sad. I was in pain.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I had broken a lot of ore. I lived with other kids in the mines, we loved each other, and we were all going to die for nothing.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Strong feelings hatched in my chest, the deaths of both my parents and my grandmother played vividly in my mind.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: When the execution started, my Arts erupted from within me, killing the four soldiers carrying out the execution..

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Of course, I didn't have the power to turn things around.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The children were mere cattle to the overseers, who, as soldiers, carried sharp blades and wore solid armor, and we were like bugs who just managed to sting them.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The cries of my siblings reached my ears just as they knocked me to the ground and the final wave of slaughter was about to begin...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: A guerrilla band arrived.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: That was Buldrokkas'tee's team.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: All the Ursus soldiers guarding the Infected on the northern tundra have dreams, and this squad is their worst nightmare.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: If I could be, I would be.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: They killed every last executioner right before us, and the Infected children in the mine escaped.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: It's just...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The blood of my less fortunate companions and that of the dead soldiers flowed together and crystallized into ice on the inhumanly white ground.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: And I realized something, in that moment...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: These Ursus soldiers were just following orders, at first. They shed the same blood as us.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Words and stories and fabricated animosity planted the root of cruelty and indifference in their bodies.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: It was Ursus that turned them into this.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Hiss, hmm....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Please.... Do me a favor.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: In the left pocket of my jacket, there's are some candies. Take one.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ...You can also take one for yourself if you want to try it.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Afraid it's poisoned?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Maybe you don't like candy, but you can try it. You can't get this kind of candy in Lungmen.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: It's an Ursus specialty. Eat one, and there's one less in the world.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Consider it payback for helping me with the candy. Try it.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Oh? Looks like you've got a taste for snacks after all.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Just a warning, the sugar may be completely different from anything you've ever had before.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: But life is short. You should try something new, right?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Please put the candy in my mouth. Careful, not to touch my skin.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: From my fingertips to my neck, I'm paralyzed. I can only move from the neck up.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: But I can still freeze you instantly with even the slightest movement of my tongue.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: So don't worry. If you offend me, you'll be dead soon enough.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Thank you.
It tastes very spicy.
It tastes extremely spicy.
It tastes horrifically spicy.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The look on your face....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Hehehe....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Sorry, couldn't resist teasing you a bit.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I've made that joke so many times that no one falls for it anymore.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: And now at last..... I saw a chance. Sorry, I just.... couldn't help myself.

options: Why do you eat this stuff?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Because I'm cold.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I told you to be careful, because even if you touch just the tiniest bit of my skin, you'll get severe frostbite.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: If you had touched me before, I would have been able to tell by your reaction. You didn't. You didn't try to kill me.

options: This phenomenon is beyond the accounts of extant academic sources.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: My cold goes even beyond winter itself.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The heat from the outside world cannot penetrate the bitter cold that surrounds my body. I love hot drinks because I can feel the warmth of the drink as the hot stream slides down my esophagus and into my stomach....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Sadly, my insides get burned by hot drinks.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The only pleasure I have left is this mix of alcohol and stimulating spices, with a little candy, if you can call it that.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: This warm feeling, even if it's only a brief illusion, brings me a bit of comfort.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Sorry for teasing you earlier.

options: So, you just said it was cold because....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Oripathy created this horrible body of mine.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: At that moment, however, Buldrokkas'tee held my ice cold body that had never known warmth close to his chest.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: He didn't care at all that I'd frozen his unarmored arms to the point of partial necrosis.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I'm not sure if it was the emotions he was feeling at the time that infected me or not.... But I stayed awake and survived in the end.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: He's my whole family. As a young child, he was all I had.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Like I said, I don't remember much about my birth father.... Subconsciously, I did indeed thought of the huge beast as my real family. Hard to say.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: It's just that, despite his appearance, he's sentimental and stubborn in places, and isn't it funny that such a man used to be a killing machine for Ursus?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: It's not funny, is it? I can't laugh either.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: He was once a war hero of Ursus, who retired to a certain city-state in his old age.

options: As a soldier of Ursus, but fighting for the Infected?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: If you don't take Ursus at their word, you'll see that he's in good company. Although, there is only one that the Infected call 'Patriot'.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: His wife died young and he is survived by his son.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: By the way, he's a Sarkaz. From the most vicious Sarkaz clan at that. Still, his son became a scholar, a Wendigo scholar.... Perhaps the first in the history of Ursus.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Buldrokkas'tee contracted Oripathy during his last battle.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: His men helped him hide his illness, and he had even hidden everything from his own son. He didn't want to drag his son down with him, only to die in some dark corner of the world with the disease.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: However, during the 'Great Rebellion', his son was campaigning for the rights of the Infected. Long out of touch with his father, the son still sees him as an Ursus puppet.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: And he was. They commanded him to keep order in his own ranks at all costs. He allowed the soldiers to use their weapons, conflict erupted, and corpses piled in the snow drifts.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: That's who he was.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Then he saw his son on the street, his body by then completely cold.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I wonder if he thought of his son when he hugged me?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: His son fought for the Infected in his own way, and Buldrokkas'tee believed he had killed his own son.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: His team left with him. Since then, the Northwest Tundra has had a guerrilla force that strikes fear into the hearts of Ursus who dare to abuse the Infected.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The old beast never said a word of any of this to me.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: He probably does think of me as his daughter. But I also want him to tell me this stuff, in his own words, to me.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I learned it all from his men. But Buldrokkas'tee himself won't speak to anyone.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: That monster of a stubborn old man with a fragile and porous heart.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: His team had passed through four mines before saving us children.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The kids in those four camps weren't as lucky as us. They found their bodies buried in the collapsed mines, and the company of soldiers that carried out the executions were nowhere to be found.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: What did he find in me? Affection? Redemption? Or a little psychological comfort? I'm not sure.

options: Is coughing and internal bleeding also a symptom of your.... infection?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Probably, maybe. Probably just the result of me overusing my Arts.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: It got pretty intense today. This sort of thing has only happened once before.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Unconsciousness, general paralysis, and the inability to move around even when conscious, have all happened. I know my own body.

options: You can't use your Arts again.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Oh are you going to fight for me now?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Rhodes Islander.... What do I call you?

options: You can call me what the Rhodes Island operators do.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ...I admit that you Rhodes Islanders can fight. But I still don't trust you. Not to mention the fact that you're supposed to be a pharmaceutical company.

options: Rhodes Island does a lot of things.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: What happens outside of combat is none of my business.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I watched you fight in Chernobog. You have a strong stance, something I confirmed with my own eyes, but I couldn't judge your character.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ...I heard that Alex died at your hands. It makes me doubt your path.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Now, I can't let you leave Chernobog and cause more harm to Reunion's Infected.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: But you're willing to listen to so much of my crap....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I'm going to assume you're not exactly as the other Infected describe.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Who wouldn't be afraid of the one who brings death?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, are you scared, right now??

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: It's normal to feel fear.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: It means you still have attachment to the world, and you still have much to do.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Do you really feel fear?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I doubt it.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: If you look so peaceful in the face of death, then I think maybe you really have no attachments at all.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Interesting. You are not scared?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I guess those who do not fear death have little love left for the world.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: A question I think about all the time....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: 'Am I afraid of death?'

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I've heard that the Ursus garrisons call me the Yeti Princess, the Wintry Death....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The truth is, we were just a few ragtag squads wandering the tundra, barely scraping by.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: My Arts were powerful, I proved as much to my enemies and teammates alike.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Of course, my body, as you can see, is only that of an Oripathy sufferer.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I felt special, not because of my illness, but because of the feelings my frost instilled in me.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I saw my ability as a blessing, but Buldrokkas'tee, that grumpy old fart, treated it like a curse.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I couldn't feel the cold as we waded through the deep mud in the swamp, icy water soaking my legs.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The old man wouldn't let go into battle, even as his soldiers took heavy casualties.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: He lit his oil lamp and sat quietly at the table by himself. I think he was crying, but I couldn't be sure, and I didn't know if I should comfort him.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: In my fifth year, I summoned a cold stream for the first time in the face of the enemy.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: One soldier was frozen into a block of ice, another accidentally fell on the block and they both shattered into pieces.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I joined the fight, the soldiers looked at me in awe, my brothers and sisters were proud of me, and other infected said——

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: 'That's our big sister. She saved all our lives.'

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Did my Arts actually save anyone?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The children from the mine carried the Originium crystals I had made, and we became the 'Yeti Squad'.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Those crystals radiate my cold, and we bring frost and vengeance to the enemies of the Infected.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: But that's really... just cold. The cold of winter that won't birth new life.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Even so, I feel very lucky. For my brothers and sisters could survive.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: We could live in this world.

options: Have you ever wanted to coexist with ordinary people?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Ordinary people....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: What do you mean by ordinary people?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The unarmed but cold-eyed citizens of Chernobog who watch the infected being put to death? Or the Ursus conscripts in the mines who take pleasure in shooting us?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Every time I think of the faces of those overseers, I grit my teeth and fantasize about slitting their throats and drinking their blood....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: But I don't hate the Ursus.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: As our guerrillas trudged through the snow, retreated from the valley, and were even chased by the Ursus army....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: It was the Ursus who would put a few cups of breadbrew in their windows.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The Ursus have never been cold-blooded creatures. The only enemy I have is the Empire of Ursus that has tormented the Infected so.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I don't think of ordinary people as the enemy. Ursus who are taught to hate the Infected are just ordinary people until they are blinded by that hate.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: It's only because 'enemies kill each other' that we've fought as we have. That's all.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I'm an Infected person, yes.... But before that, I was a normal person.

options: What about what Reunion is doing now?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ...My main conflict with Buldrokkas'tee is in his work to protect the Infected community.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: 'Reunion, first name. That. Infected, can rely on.'

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: 'No matter where, Reunion goes. No matter what, it does. We cannot, abandon it. To lose Reunion, is to lose, Infected conviction. Fight for: conviction.'

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: That's what the old man says. That's what the old man believes.

options: Why do you keep pausing like that?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Because that's how he talks now. I was just, *ahem*, preserving his cadence..

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, do you know why Rhodes Island is a nameless pharmaceutical company?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Because you can't take a stand on the world stage. As soon as you take that step, you'll become what Reunion is now.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: You will go down this road.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Hmm.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: After a dozen years of rolling around on the tundra, an Infected woman reached out to us. She said, 'Come with me, and let us break all chains.'

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Imagine it: we met in the ruins of an old city that had become a battlefield. She was alone, carrying nothing but her roster and a book of ledgers.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Even the things she said I found impractical to the point of ridiculousness.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: But she said to us, 'Come with me.'

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: She fought with us, and with her strength and ideals, she became our friend. Together we left the snowy plains and headed for the cities of Ursus.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Whether was the words she spat out after pausing to think, or the swing of her great sword as she slashed alongside me, her power was real, and plenty impressive.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: When the wounded needed treatment, she was there. When discussing strategy and philosophy with the Infected, she was there. And when fighting against the Ursus death squads, she was also there.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ...We even get to dine with some regular people. She didn't care. There was nothing in her eyes but the purest authenticity.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Our team grew and so did our friendships. The people brought in were good at fighting, and they were good people.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: At the time, I considered her my friend. She quietly helped me make these candies, even though she was terrible at it and they tasted worse.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: She made a funny face as she ate them. Then she'd force a smile at me.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: It was really something. She worked so hard to put on a brave face. It made me laugh.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Everything's different now.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Chernobog was destroyed by a Catastrophe, as you can well see. All the normal people here died or became newly Infected.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Their eyes were dead. No desire to live anymore whatsoever.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: If this is what she wanted, then we never should have followed her.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: And in case you didn't know, here's a secret....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: She's planning to take over Lungmen. She says it won't be like Chernobog, and that the Infected will get their own city instead of a giant ruin like this place.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Would you trust someone like that?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: If she's acting, then she's the greatest actress the world has ever seen.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: But there's a thought stuck in my head.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: 'What are my chances of winning if I went up against her?'

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Once we part ways, once I find out she's been lying to the Infected, or that she's been plotting against them...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I will fight her. She must know the price of betrayal.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: My countless deadly battles with Ursus have cleansed my mind and honed my skills.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I say with the utmost conviction: even if I cannot defeat her, I can let death take her from the world along with me.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The stubborn old man wouldn't agree with me. He's fought too long, and his old age is driving him down a path that leads only to sacrifice.

options: You don't agree with your father's ways.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: He is strong against his enemies and he is loyal to his friends. But when he needs to stand up for them, he will face the reality that his friends make him weak.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The old man who has believed in people all his life.... The old curmudgeon never thinks about what to do after being betrayed.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Maybe he's already taken that bitter pill. He bore the pain of betrayal over and over again his whole life, and he said nothing.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Whether it's an Infected who heard about Reunion and decided to join up, or an Infected who feels they can get away with anything.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Reunion is factionalizing and our leaders are doing nothing to stop it.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I will definitely go back to Chernobog after the Lungmen business is over. This time, I must face her.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Because... I am not long for this world.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ...I promised my brothers I'd find a home for everyone. Before I fall, I have to make good on my promise...

options: Why are you telling me all this?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Because the look in your eyes tells me that you're not just another executioner.

options: I'm not sure if I am.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: It's best to doubt yourself. It's the only way you won't go through life fanatically convinced of something.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ...Do you hear voices outside?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: It sounds like they're digging above us.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: And my body is....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Well.... I can move my fingers already.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Thanks for helping me pass the time.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, I'd like to make a bet with you.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: If your people dig us out first...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I will kill all of you in the blink of an eye.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: If my brothers and sisters break through first, your life ends here.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Wanna bet?
